The main takeaway from our work is that
the surface critical behaviour in aperiodic systems can be extremely sensitive to the form of the modulation.
aperiodic modulations can lead to new critical behaviour, which has no counterpart in the periodic case.
, in aperiodic systems, aperiodic modulation can be more relevant than the aperiodicity itself.
